text: Has many cool features such as the Yap zone to do brain dumps quickly and convert into tasks later. Also like that it can take some historical tasks and suggest tasks to do if you're stuck. One minor issue is that the app size is too large on my screen and ends up getting blocked by the home screen buttons on the bottom and the notifications bar at the top. Other than that, there is great potential and the developer is super friendly and actively engaging with users for feedback.
author: Emily Leung
developer_reply: Thank you for the feedback and patience Emily! We're working on making Hypermonkey fit nicely on devices of different sizes in the next release. Please stay tuned for that! :D
